chunks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ الرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: فِي قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ:

translations.en: Al-Ridha عليه السلام said regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «الْمَلَائِكَةُ تُقَسِّمُ أَرْزَاقَ بَنِي آدَمَ مَا بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ إِلَى طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ فَمَنْ يَنَامُ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُمَا يَنَامُ عَنْ رِزْقِهِ.

translations.en: He said: "The angels distribute the sustenance of the children of Adam between the rising of dawn and the rising of the sun. So whoever sleeps between them sleeps away from his sustenance."

en.summary: Imam al-Ridha عليه السلام explains the verse as referring to angels who distribute provisions for the children of Adam. The narration highlights the time between dawn and sunrise as significant for one's livelihood, discouraging sleep during that period.
en.seo_question: What does «فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ أَمْرًا» mean, and why is sleeping after Fajr considered disliked?

key_terms.فَالْمُقَسِّمَاتِ: those who distribute by Allah’s command
key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةُ: the angels who carry out divine distribution
key_terms.أَرْزَاقَ: provisions and sustenance apportioned to people
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ: the rise of dawn, marking the beginning of the period mentioned
key_terms.طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ: sunrise, marking the end of the period mentioned
